description: Exactly 72 public-safe synthetic structural cases for the Accepted ARCH-044 Profile Definition Schema Resource, pending separately governed integration: 11 expected valid and 61 expected invalid. Every result remains separate. Expected validity proves no source truth, Profile conformance, Context Packet or Task Contract validity, authenticity, integrity, freshness, applicability, approval, certification, release fitness, deployment fitness, or final-human authority.

caseConstruction.method: Each ordered case deep-copies baseInstance and applies its operations in order.
caseConstruction.pointerSyntax: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; add with a terminal hyphen appends to an array.
caseConstruction.nonNormativeBoundary: This mechanical fixture representation is test evidence only. It is not a Profile representation, Serialization Binding, validator, migration, patch protocol, runtime, or implementation contract.

scope.purpose: Apply the exact Profile to one synthetic Context Packet revision.
scope.materialityBoundary: Only the exact synthetic Task Contract-relative source boundary.
prohibitedUses: No source-truth, approval, release, deployment, or authority inference.
